Type: white metal lantern for a pillar candle
Use: holding a block candle on a table, floor or windowsill; living room, dining room, patio
Style: farmhouse, coastal, traditional
Materials: white powder-coated steel, clear glass panels
Colors: white, clear glass
Shape: square lantern with a hinged glass door, slatted cupola top, round carrying ring, flat square base, tall and light
Feel: cozy, inviting, fresh, romantic
Goes with: white candles, light wood, natural linen, green plants; farmhouse, coastal or Scandinavian rooms and porches
